reviews.author: Brandy Chaparro
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this company. I dropped in with a question on a day that my agent was at another office and a different agent took time out of her lunch to contact her for me. I appreciate that I didn't get told to come back later. My agent then contacted me and helped my obtain the insurance I needed.

reviews.author: Annette Oseguera
reviews.text: Kicker Insures Me is a great agency. They take care of everything for me. As a busy teacher, I appreciate the text message and email reminders for my insurance renewals. They search for the best home insurance policy to suit my needs. Thank you for your professional, competent, caring service.

reviews.author: Melissa Ferstl
reviews.text: Kicker and her team have managed my insurance needs for years. The customer service has always been fantastic. They are proactive and always seem to want the best for their clients. Great follow through, rates and customer service. I highly recommend them!

about.title: Insurance made clear, before you need it
text: As an independent agency, we work for you, not the carriers, so we can compare top-rated companies and find coverage at the right price.
Kicker Cardenas is president and principal agent, and we say what sets us apart is our people, our processes and our personality.

If a claim happens, we are your in-house claims liaison and walk you through the whole process. We also don't necessarily recommend shopping carriers every year, because switching that often can hurt your insurance score.
